help.subtitle: Getting started, common questions, and how to reach us.
help.s1Body: Under School units, click Open school to enter the school dashboard.
help.s2Body: Fill in the academic year, classes, and subjects, then add teachers and students.
help.s3Body: Give teachers and staff accounts with the right roles.
help.s4Body: Check the validity and pay the renewal before it is due.
help.f1Q: When do extra modules become active?
help.f1A: Added modules and a higher student tier take effect as soon as payment is confirmed. The cost is prorated for the rest of the period.
help.f2Q: When does removing a module take effect?
help.f2A: A removed module stays active until the end of the current period, then disappears next period and is no longer billed.
help.f3Q: What happens if an invoice is late?
help.f3A: There is a grace period after the due date. After it, the unit is suspended temporarily and reopened automatically once the invoice is paid.
help.f4Q: How do I add another school?
help.f4A: Open School units, click Add school unit, enter the name and address, pick modules, and pay. The unit is created automatically and you become its first admin.
help.f5A: Only institution managers. Teachers and school staff sign in at their own school address.
help.contactBody: Send an email and include your institution name.
